title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
study_context: Reporting guideline for development and evaluation of clinical prediction models using regression or machine learning.
population_or_data: Consensus-based guideline development; not a patient cohort.
task: Specify minimum transparent reporting for prediction-model studies.
method: International consensus process producing a 27-item checklist with 52 subitems.
main_findings: TRIPOD+AI covers data, model development, evaluation, fairness, open science, performance, limitations, and generalizability reporting.
limitations: A reporting guideline does not by itself establish low risk of bias or prescribe one correct study design.
does_not_establish: Checklist adherence is not evidence that a model is clinically useful, unbiased, or externally valid.
relevance_to_project: Reporting contract for patient flow, clustered data, model specification, calibration, uncertainty, and code/data availability.
